description:
Han Seo-won, a female theater actor who is outstanding in acting skills but fails every audition she sees in a low voice that is often mistaken for a man, too tall for a woman. Even if you don't have recognition, you don't have too much, so you deceive gender in a historical drama while you're in a trick, audition, and then be cast unconventionally. Her role is the 'King of Seogong' of the Unified Silla period. In history, he ascends to the throne at a young age and makes various achievements in culture and science, He is a king of bad luck who faces a sad death at a young age due to the rebellion of his opponent. Ahead of the long-awaited first filming, Seowon transcends time and space, changing his body with the "King Seogong" in history.
